[CONTRIBUTION EVENT]
- Type: Time (Minutes)
- Amount: 90
- Description: Farm/program media people-index tiers + biometric consent gates (design + minors hard gate)
  
  Pull requests (GitHub evidence):
  - https://github.com/TrueSightDAO/agentic_ai_context/pull/1478
  
  Details:
  Design + documentation work (thread 39733): codified the tier boundary for representing people in farm/program media, and filed a hard blocking gate on biometric work.
  
  Authored plans/FARM_MEDIA_PEOPLE_TIERS.md:
  - Tier 0 (provenance) / Tier 1 (people-count, no names) = shippable now; Tier 2 (transient cluster IDs) / Tier 3 (face/voice biometrics) = consent-gated.
  - Mechanical gates so the count->who leak is caught by construction, not review: G1 closed schema (additionalProperties: false), G2 negative-injection test (known-name payload must be REJECTED), G3 namespaced cluster IDs (<entity_id>:c<hash>, non-joinable across batches), G4 "transient" = within-batch, non-persisted.
  - Identity model: transient cluster IDs primary; pk_hash only as optional, later, governor-confirmed link. Verified against DEDUP_KEY_CONVENTION.md section 2.7 (pk_hash is a join key, "not a privacy device").
  - Proxy-attestation gap for non-registered adults (proxy attestation + archived paper release).
  - Consent as signed events: [BIOMETRIC CONSENT EVENT] + [BIOMETRIC CONSENT REVOCATION EVENT]. Verified there is no working per-person consent mechanism to mirror: literal public_listable:true is hardcoded at record creation in tokenomics program_admin_endpoint.js::paProcessOneEvent; lineage-credentials has zero occurrences; CREDENTIALING_PROGRAM_PAGES.md calls the flag "future"/Phase-5-"(Optional)"/advisory.
  
  Edited OPEN_FOLLOWUPS.md:
  - Filed the minors gate under ## Pending as an explicit HARD BLOCK on all Tier 2/3 work, not a nice-to-have. Biometric indexing of a minor is doubly gated under LGPD (Art. 11 sensitive data + Art. 14 guardian consent), and minors are the DAO's default media population (CFR Anapu/CEPOTX, Butterfly Effect, Tribo Bahir Mirim), not an edge case. Cites the three docs where the DAO already anticipated it.
  
  Docs-only markdown change in agentic_ai_context; no code/CI surface touched. Reviewed & merged at Gary Teh's direction.
- Contributor(s): Sophia Truesight
- TDG Issued: 150.00
